core_obligations: Preserve the exact sequence-growth and minimum-overlap assumptions of Theorem14.
Retain full entropy extraction, iterative loss/potential analysis and independence coupling.
Retain complete author fixed-set proof as support, not a separate counted item.
difficulty_reason: The author alternates a fixed-set product approximation with a covering-and-probe-fixing argument that reduces total probe potential while controlling entropy loss. A maximal low-intersection set terminates the iteration and product coupling converts low probe intersections into almost pairwise independent outputs. This generic separator is explicitly a main technical contribution.
